newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 -USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog receipts Friday were 105,000 head, compared with 97,000 a week ago and 89,000 a year ago. Saturday's estimate was 10,000 head, compared with 8,000 a week ago and 20,000 a year ago.
Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts steady compared to midsession Thursday. Trade and demand moderate for light to moderate offerings.
Sows: uneven, 500 dn steady to 1.00 higher, 500 up steady to 1.00 lower. US 1-3 300-450 lbs. 43.00 -45.00 45.00 -46.00

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts 2.50-3.00 higher. Sows steady to 1.00 lower. Receipts this week 497,000 last week 447,000, last year 465,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending May 30, 1997 2 55.1 lbs compared to 253.2 lbs previous week 249.0 lbs last year.
